files.README.md:
# MQTT live topics

Create a Service connection with serviceType `mqtt`. Nonsecret settings:

```json
{"url":"mqtt://mosquitto:1883","topics":["homelab/status/#","sensors/+/temperature"],"publishTopics":["homelab/commands/refresh"]}
```

Encrypted credentials: {"username":"homarr","password":"YOUR_BROKER_PASSWORD"}. The browser never receives credentials through SDK connection APIs. TLS brokers use mqtts://. This adapter uses MQTT.js’s client constructor with Node TCP/TLS streams. Optional nonsecret settings ca/cert/rejectUnauthorized configure TLS; keep tlsKey in encrypted credentials. Use a distinct connection when broker or credential sets differ.

The server adapter opens an authenticated subscription only while observed, disables hidden reconnect loops and closes on cancellation, errors and worker shutdown. The host shares matching subscriptions across surfaces. The browser retains 64 recent events; the worker queue is bounded to 64 messages and each payload to 64 KiB. The tile shows latest topic values; advanced view shows recent messages and a nonretained publish action. Only explicit publishTopics accept publishes, with 4 KiB payloads and QoS 1. Clear publishTopics for a read-only dashboard. Broker permissions still apply. Public guest actions are off by default.

Diagnose verifies TCP reachability for mqtt:// and mqtts://. Run preview to validate TLS, broker credentials and topic authorization; use reconnect after fixing the service. Enabling live SDK actions is required to actually publish from preview. No HTTP URL or proxy is involved. This package pins mqtt@5.15.2 and supports-color@8.1.1 (debug’s optional JavaScript dependency); review and trust installs its dependency tree with lifecycle scripts disabled. Source: https://github.com/mqttjs/MQTT.js
